text:
Alicia (AE): Heads-up — NovaBank is asking for BYO-HSM (CloudHSM equivalent), mandatory customer key rotation every 30 days, and a dual-signatory offline key ceremony during cutover. They also want a VPC-hosted connector for the POC (no public egress allowed) and a per-KMS-op pricing breakdown for budgeting. Can we confirm feasibility and any gotchas? @Tom @Priya @Luke

Tom (Solutions Eng): Short answer: feasible but two notable constraints. 1) If we cannot egress from public IPs, we need a connector in their VPC (temporary for POC or permanent for Private). 2) Frequent 30-day rotations with on-demand ceremony increases ops work; we should clarify if rotation automation is allowed or if they require manual dual-sign at every rotation.

Priya (CryptoEng): Crypto details: we support PKCS#11 and vendor TLS APIs. We never export customer private keys. Our model: customer KEK in their HSM wraps the data-encryption key (DEK). Rotation options: automated rewrap (recommended) or manual ceremony. For dual-signatory offline ceremonies we can support a scheduled window; procedure: generate new KEK, perform wrap/unwrap validation, promote, then retire old KEK after shadow period. We'll need HSM vendor certs, HSM operator contact, and the CIDR range for any connector-hosted endpoint.

Luke (SRE): Networking/ops: For a VPC connector we stand up a small connector VM (or k8s pod) in their account/peering. ETA ~10 business days for security review + infra. POC quick option: they allocate a NAT with 3 static egress IPs we publish. If they insist on tight per-source firewall rules and autoscaling on our side, autoscale won't work without a NAT or connector in their VPC. Latency note: remote unwrap/sign adds ~25-60ms depending on region.

Alicia (AE): They explicitly refuse public egress. They also said legal requires an auditable MoM for the ceremony and retention of the transcript. Can we produce logs proving no private key egress?

Priya (CryptoEng): Yes — we log key operations (opaque audit entries) and can provide an attestation that private key material is never exported. We store audit trails (operation id, caller, timestamp, result) but never raw key bytes. For legal MoM we can provide a templated ceremony checklist + an exportable audit bundle. Note: providing raw HSM debugging logs may require their approval due to vendor TOS.

Tom (Solutions Eng): Pricing: POC pricing = one-time connector setup $4,000 + connector hosting fee $800/mo (infra + monitoring) if in their VPC. BYO-HSM ops surcharge $1,500/mo (for dedicated routing and runbook). Per-KMS-op rate: $0.03 per sign/unwrap (metered). Ceremony professional services (onsite/remote facilitation) estimated at $2,500 per ceremony. These are ballpark numbers; legal/Sales to confirm final SOW line items.

SecurityBot: SSQ entry autogenerated: https://redwood.internal/ssq/2270010000-novabank. Key answers: supports CMK, no private key export, 2-phase rotation supported, mTLS/PKCS#11 onboarding required. See section 5 for audit/tracing.

Luke (SRE): CURL handshake example for POC (they'll need client cert & key):

curl -v --cert connector-client.crt --key connector-client.key \
  -H "Host: hsm.novabank.internal" \
  https://hsm.novabank.internal/v1/healthz

Also need their expected qps and max concurrent unwraps to size connector (suggest we ask for peak QPS with 95th percentile).

Priya (CryptoEng): Blocker callout: if NovaBank wants split-key escrow (multi-custodian) we treat that as an SOW add-on — design + secure key-splitting tooling required. If they want hardware-backed split keys, we need to validate vendor support.

Alicia (AE): Action list: 1) Tom: capture pricing sheet and SOW draft; 2) Luke: scope VPC connector timeline + exact infra cost; 3) Priya: send HSM onboarding doc + ceremony checklist; 4) Alicia: forward SSQ link to NovaBank and request vendor cert chain, HSM operator contact, CIDR block, and expected QPS. I'll schedule a sync with their CISO for Friday.

Tom (Solutions Eng): I'll upload the draft pricing/SOW to the sales folder and tag legal for review.

Luke (SRE): I'll begin infra scoping and post estimated calendar ETA + cost numbers by EOD tomorrow.

Priya (CryptoEng): Uploading onboarding + ceremony playbook now (internal link). Include 2-phase rollover diagrams and test vectors.

Alicia (AE): Thanks — will report back after the CISO call. :white_check_mark:
